meta.title: Dawah dictionary: Japanese phrases for Muslim life
meta.description: Japanese words and ready-made sentences for prayer, halal food, daily errands, and emergencies. Show the big Japanese text to the person you are talking to, copy it, or hear it spoken.

title: Say what you need, in Japanese, without hesitation.
description: Each entry has the word, its reading, and a polite sentence you can show on your screen. Tap Show for a full-screen version readable from a meter away.

search.label: Search the dictionary
search.empty: Nothing matches. Try another word or switch category.

show.title: Show this screen
show.hint: Turn your phone to the person you are talking to.

tips.title: Three ways to use an entry

0.name: Show
0.detail: Opens the Japanese sentence in very large text with the translation underneath, so you can simply hold up your phone.

1.name: Copy
1.detail: Copies the Japanese sentence to paste into a message, a form, or a translation app.

2.name: Listen
2.detail: Plays the sentence with your device's Japanese voice when it is available, so you can practice the pronunciation.
